MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

3. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.

4. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

6. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.

5. C — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

7. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Aloud; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

9. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Aloud; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for Fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
